brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements without serious or minor error, qualifying for Acceptable or higher. At least three high-order points (HO1: tailored communication for anxious caregiver; HO2: feasible navigation steps; HO3: correcting medication confusion) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. All dimensions are good or excellent. Closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid.
